latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of social-media-cover-generator.
- Generates platform-optimized social media cover images by converting user-supplied titles into HTML and PNGs.
- Supports presets for Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Weibo, Douyin, Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
- Includes design templates, font recommendations, and color schemes for visually appealing results.
- Automates HTML to PNG conversion using a built-in script and Puppeteer.
